tasks.short: Turn pay and benefits research into reports and employee guides for Noordhaven.

today.trigger: An annual compensation review or an HR Director request requires a report, benefits manual or presentation. This is an inferred company equivalent of the O*NET publication task.
steps: Collect approved research findings, benchmark sources and relevant CAO and policy extracts.
Check tables against dated AFAS extracts and Power BI reports, distinguishing employees from agency workers.
Write the findings, limitations and practical implications in Word, then prepare charts or slides.
Ask the HR Director and relevant specialists to review factual accuracy and policy wording.
Revise and release the approved document through SharePoint, with audience-specific communication.
systems: Power BI, using the nightly AFAS extract
drudgery: Copying figures between spreadsheets, reports and slides.
Reformatting tables and checking source references.
Repeating the same explanation for managers and employees.
Reconciling reviewer edits across document versions.
today.time_sinks: Likely concentrated in assembling evidence, drafting and revisions. The supplied baseline is 16 hours annually; the actual split and review delays need measurement.

lenses.faster: Use a fixed publication template and an approved evidence pack to produce the first draft, chart captions and source list together. Manual copying and repeated rewriting largely disappear.
lenses.autonomous: An approved evidence pack can trigger a draft and a missing-information checklist. Publication and interpretation of CAO provisions still require human approval.
lenses.ambitious: Produce a clear employee guide alongside each compensation report, with examples for office staff and shift workers at Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo. Explain how approved benefits work and gather questions that reveal gaps in understanding.
lenses.joy: Remove formatting, reference assembly and repetitive wording changes. Keep the work of explaining tradeoffs fairly and making benefits understandable.
lenses.options: Generate three versions from the same evidence: an HR Director briefing, a works council discussion paper and an employee guide. Compare wording that explains uncertainty without hiding it.
lenses.altitude: Own the standards for compensation publications: approved sources, calculation definitions, review responsibilities and release criteria. Spend more time checking whether the evidence supports the message.
reach: Prepare benefits explanations for Recruiter offer packs.
Draft compensation briefing materials for HR Business Partners and managers.
Help the People Analytics and HRIS Analyst turn approved findings into readable reports.

tasks.human_edge: The specialist judges whether comparisons are fair across CAOs, sites and working patterns, explains sensitive findings, and owns the wording employees and the works council will rely on.
tasks.pattern_why: Drafting and formatting are suitable for assistance, but conclusions and publication remain the specialist's responsibility. At 16 hours a year, a reusable template and controlled drafting step are more proportionate than a dedicated publishing agent; calculations and reconciliation should use deterministic software.

in_practice.trigger: The specialist marks a research evidence pack as ready for drafting in a restricted SharePoint location.
steps: Assemble approved aggregate tables, dated sources, CAO extracts and an audience brief; exclude unnecessary personal records.
Use Excel checks to reconcile totals, reporting dates and employee populations, flagging inconsistencies before drafting.
Have an approved language-model tool draft the report and audience variants using only the evidence pack, with source references and explicit gaps.
Have the specialist verify every figure, conclusion and CAO statement, then obtain the relevant editorial and policy approvals.
Publish the approved version in SharePoint and record the evidence version, reviewers and release date.
in_practice.human_gate: The specialist approves all substantive content. The HR Director approves the release where required; proposed policy changes go through their separate decision and applicable works council process.
systems: SharePoint with restricted evidence and publication libraries
Word and PowerPoint for final documents
An approved language-model drafting tool; availability and data terms must be confirmed
Teams or Outlook for review coordination
data_needed: Approved aggregate compensation and benefits findings, with reporting dates and population definitions.
Relevant versions of CAO Beroepsgoederenvervoer, the warehouse CAO and company policies.
Benchmark source details, permissions and methodological limitations.
Publication templates, audience requirements and named reviewers.
Approved definitions of any offer acceptance or 90-day retention measures discussed.
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted SharePoint publication register containing source versions, calculation checks, draft versions, reviewer decisions and the final release link, without duplicating employee-level pay records.

evidence.claim: A language model can draft reports and audience variants from supplied findings, with human verification of figures, references and conclusions.
Excel checks and reusable document templates can reduce copying and formatting in this proposed workflow.
Saving 40% of the supplied 16 annual hours would free 6.4 hours, worth EUR 480 at the supplied loaded rate; this is an untested estimate of capacity, not cash savings.

risks: A polished draft may invent references, overstate research findings or confuse CAO minimums with Noordhaven policy; verify against the approved sources.
Nightly Power BI data can differ from a later AFAS export. Record reporting dates and reconcile populations, including the treatment of flex workers.

Small groups may reveal individual pay even in aggregate tables. Apply restricted access and disclosure checks consistent with AVG/GDPR data minimisation. [European Commission GDPR principles](https://commission.europa.eu/law/law-topic/data-protection/information-business-and-organisations/principles-gdpr_en)

Assess EU AI Act classification if the use expands from drafting publications to recommendations affecting individual employment terms; the intended use matters. [European Commission AI Act employment guidance](https://ai-act-service-desk.ec.europa.eu/en/employment-0?trk=public_post_comment-text)
Published wording may be understood as a benefits commitment. Confirm policy authority, effective dates and any applicable works council involvement before release.
Setup and review overhead could consume the annual savings because this task occurs infrequently.
research_questions: Of the 16 annual hours, how much is drafting and formatting versus interpreting findings and waiting for review?
Can a trial draft preserve every figure, source and limitation while reducing total preparation and review time by at least 40%?
Can the approved tool process the required evidence under Noordhaven's access, retention and data-use requirements?
Do employees, managers and works council reviewers understand the assisted drafts better, and can the template be reused enough to recover its setup cost?

role.altitude: Become the owner of clear, evidence-based compensation communication: define publication standards, verify conclusions and connect employee questions to improvements in benefits design.
reach: Benefits content for recruitment offers and onboarding materials.
Compensation communication support for HR Business Partners.
Publication of approved people analytics findings.
Employee-facing explanations of approved reward policies.
role.ceiling_note: This single supplemental task offers an estimated 6.4 hours of annual capacity, about 0.4% of role time using the supplied 1% task share. It cannot establish savings for the rest of the role. CAO interpretation, sensitive conversations and policy accountability continue to require specialist judgment.
skills_to_grow: Evidence checking and clear explanation of research limitations.
Excel reconciliation and reusable document templates.
Writing benefits guidance for office and shift-worker audiences.
Privacy-aware reporting and controlled AI drafting.
Understanding when proposed policy changes require works council involvement.
role.ambitious_version: Maintain an approved library of compensation explanations that supports offers, onboarding and manager conversations across all three sites. Work with recruiting and people analytics to test whether clearer benefits communication improves offer acceptance and supports hires who are productive and still employed at day 90, without claiming that publication alone causes those outcomes.
